entities.name: Kinsbaile
entities.description: The largest kithkin clachan in Lorwyn, a trading hub of about 600 residents.

entities.name: Gaddock Teeg
entities.description: Cenn who led Kinsbaile at the Great Aurora.

entities.name: Colfenor
entities.description: Treefolk sage, former teacher of Rhys.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: Daen of Gilt-Leaf hunters hunted as a traitor.

entities.name: Ashling
entities.description: Flamekin whose rekindling caused Colfenor to burn.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: Killed the population of Kinsbaile's Shadowmoor counterpart.

entities.name: Claide Fiobhan
entities.description: Guildmaster of the Curiosities Traders' Guild.

events.summary: The Gilt-Leaf occupy Kinsbaile waiting for the traitor Rhys, planning to punish the kithkin.
events.quote: occupied Kinsbaile and waited for the traitor

events.summary: Rhys kills Nath and the rest of the elves leave to pursue him, sparing Kinsbaile.
events.quote: Kinsbaile was spared the elvish wrath when Nath was killed by Rhys

events.summary: Ashling's rekindling causes Colfenor to burn, damaging buildings.
events.quote: the rekindling of the flamekin Ashling caused Colfenor to burn

events.summary: Kinsbaile is repopulated after its Shadowmoor counterpart's population is killed by Oona.
events.quote: Kinsbaile was repopulated after the entire population of its Shadowmoor counterpart was killed by Oona

relations.quote: the town was led by the cenn Gaddock Teeg
